get.summary: Browse authorized documents with a stable ID cursor
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Page size is configurable from 1 to 50 (default 50). Total and candidates share the same permission/filter predicates and a read-only snapshot within each response. Document content is reauthorized before projection; concurrent revocation can omit a candidate. A cursor is authoritative for whether more candidates remain. Context snapshots are read-only. Document mutations use the existing versioned knowledge API and application permission checks. Optional page reads the requested offset directly without visiting preceding pages, using the same filters, ACL, count and snapshot. Out-of-range pages return empty items with the actual total. Results may shift between requests when records are inserted or removed.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional direct page read; cannot be combined with a nonempty cursor. Omit to retain cursor mode.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. PostgreSQL source. Unset filters are unrestricted except mock resources are excluded unless source_kind=mock is explicitly selected; repeated values are OR within a field. Facets cover the authorized environment subset. Unknown environment_scope is empty, not all. Shared application links are trimmed to caller access.

post.description: Minimum role: admin. Administrator only. Validate each application/environment pair. Server sets source=manual and audit timestamps. Metadata registration never provisions infrastructure or fabricates observed health.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Aggregates caller-visible resources under existing RBAC and global environment scope. No global administrator bypass. Runtime Pods and events are separate from inventory totals; missing objects do not count as current resources. Source synchronization and metric freshness are independent of resource readiness. Node and explicitly mapped host metrics are deduplicated; 15-minute time buckets contain null for unavailable observations, never synthetic zero. No credentials or source endpoints are returned.

get.summary: Read a resource and its visible relationships
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. A resource outside caller access or global environment returns 404; both edge endpoints must be visible.

patch.description: Minimum role: viewer. Requires update permission on this exact resource. Changes only the catalog, never infrastructure.

delete.description: Minimum role: viewer. Requires delete permission on this exact resource. Only manual source resources can be removed; other sources return 409.

get.summary: Read a bounded resource relationship graph
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Static declared/discovered relationships, not runtime request traffic. At most 300 nodes and 600 edges, with explicit truncation. Mock records and edges are excluded by default and retain their source markers when explicitly selected with source_kind=mock.

get.summary: Read workspace metadata and actual configuration counts
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Configuration is not health evidence. MCP counts restricted to admins. Version comes from server build metadata; preferences are workspace defaults only.

patch.summary: Save workspace metadata with optimistic revision
patch.description: Minimum role: admin. 409 on stale revision. Owner, deployment mode, dates and version cannot be changed here. Unknown fields are rejected. Saves an audit record atomically.

get.summary: Aggregate real identity, team and application ACL records
get.description: Minimum role: admin. Mock identities are explicitly marked and database-constrained to disabled with empty passwords. Built-in roles remain authoritative; operator may approve within operate scope. Departments are existing text metadata, not an organization-tree ACL.

patch.summary: Save team owner and department metadata
patch.description: Minimum role: admin. Both fields must be explicitly provided and non-null. Nonempty owner must be an existing non-deleted team member. Ownership is metadata and does not confer application authority. Existing team/member/grant endpoints remain authoritative.

get.summary: Read own profile, department, effective resource permissions and related applications
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Current authenticated identity only. Department is the single users.department_id association. Resource capability flags use effective role/department resource bindings; empty permissions grant nothing. Related applications come only from resources with an effective view grant and are not standalone grants. is_platform_admin is derived separately from the effective admin role association. Execution still requires approved plans. Phone is nullable and read-only.

patch.description: Minimum role: viewer. Only avatar_data_url may be changed. Empty string removes avatar. Strict PNG/JPEG base64, input up to 1 MiB, dimensions up to 1024x1024 and 1048576 pixels. Image is decoded and reencoded as PNG, discarding metadata. Canonical stored PNG is bounded to 4 MiB. Avatar content never enters audit records.

post.summary: Change own local password and revoke all own sessions
post.description: Minimum role: viewer. Requires current password and a different new password. New passwords contain 8–128 Unicode characters and require ASCII uppercase and lowercase letters, ASCII digits, and at least one Unicode punctuation or symbol character; invalid values return 422 invalid_password. Existing password input retains the 1024-byte login cap, without applying new password complexity rules. Directory source is metadata, not SSO: any active identity with a valid local password hash may change it. No configured local password returns 422 no_local_password. Wrong current password returns 422 incorrect_password, preserving the session. Successful hash update, all-user-session revocation and secret-free audit are transactional; response expires the current cookie. A new login is required.

Authorization is rechecked and the last enabled RBAC manager is protected with 409 last_rbac_manager.

get.description: Text search supports literal Chinese and case-insensitive English, pinyin and initials before server count and pagination. Values within each action/resource_kind filter use OR; the two dimensions use AND on the same infrastructure resource binding, before total counting and pagination. For example action=view,update&resource_kind=host,mysql; action=view&action=update is equivalent. actions is an aggregate of associated operations, never an intrinsic permission field. Historical timestamps may be null; new definitions and subsequent metadata or resource-association edits record timestamps.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Authenticated current identity only. management_objects is the compatibility response for platform administration navigation. An enabled real user must hold the actual admin role directly or through their department; ordinary resource bindings do not grant platform administration.

get.summary: Read resource operations and department filter metadata
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Resource associations offer view, update, approve and delete on every infrastructure resource. Permission definitions have no intrinsic operations or resource scope. An unbound permission grants nothing.

Minimum role: viewer. Server count/search/filters precede LIMIT. selected is stored direct association. selected=yes/no filters projected direct selection including add_ids/remove_ids (comma-separated or repeated), leaving inherited source read-only. Mock resources retain is_mock; mock identities are excluded. User candidates with locked=true are account-managed base memberships; lock_reason explains how to change them.

put.summary: Atomically apply permission, user and department deltas
put.description: Minimum role: viewer. All three tabs commit together, with audit, including built-in roles. Account-managed base user memberships are locked and return 409 legacy_role_membership. Unknown IDs and conflicting add/remove are rejected. Authorization is rechecked in the transaction; at least one enabled RBAC manager must remain, otherwise 409 last_rbac_manager. A stale revision returns 409; no partial replacement from visible pages.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Groups contain only concrete CMDB infrastructure resources, keyed resource:<kind>. Allowed kinds: cluster, node, deployment, namespace, host, network, storage, redis, mysql, kafka. No application, legacy application or management-object groups. Every leaf supports view/update/approve/delete. scope_type is always resource; assigned_actions reflects stored bindings. Search and group load-more never modify authorization.
Minimum role: viewer. Alias of resource-tree, returns groups instead of the former paginated candidate table.

put.description: Minimum role: viewer. Each upsert replaces operations only for the supplied infrastructure resource. scope_type must be resource and actions must contain one or more of view/update/approve/delete. Remove deletes that resource binding; unmentioned targets remain unchanged. Retired scopes and actions are rejected, including when previously stored. Permission definitions carry no operations. Authorization and revision checks are atomic. Platform administration depends on actual admin role membership, not a resource operation. Recovery approval checks exact resolved infrastructure targets rather than an application-level grant.
